g.text: SCR05 — Callback subscriptions
Kotlin Compose screen definition · design only · FR-CB-01 / 02 / 03 / 04
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · r9-ready
Wide layout: persistent rail + scrollable list/detail; control contracts
SCR05.C01 · Inspect bounded status
Exact named action; protected mutations open SCR09; reads never
change authority
SCR05.C02 · Cancel via owner review
Request protected administrative cancellation in SCR09; mark
delivery closed immediately after admitted commit; status/event
terminal remains readable.
SCR05.C03 · Open navigation
Drawer on phone; rail on wide layout. Destinations
SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; Back discards only after explicit
discard/cancel decision.
SCR05.C04 · Select subscription
Owner-filtered principal, stream epoch, state, cleanup phase and
disposition
SCR05.C05 · Read event page
Bounded owned journal cursor; gap/terminal status separate from
payload
SCR05.C06 · Refresh status
Status after owner cancellation, lease expiry, death or cleanup
uncertainty
Phone · 390dp single pane
☰ Menu · SCR05 · status
Menu opens all destinations in a
modal drawer. Filters precede a
paged list. Selecting a row
replaces list with detail; Back
returns list. Scroll retains draft
and focused field.
SCR05.C01 · primary action
48dp targets; no compressed rail
All wide-layout control IDs map to
the same actions here. State
enablement below is authoritative.
State definitions — enabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR05.S0 · Depicted normal/example state
Disabled: none except standard permission/target readiness gates. Read-only until exact protected commit; error/conflict never applies a partial mutation. Owner may inspect
reason, explicitly retry when safe, or cancel/discard; no automatic uncertain write replay.
SCR05.S1 · Empty: no registrations
Disabled: SCR05.C01, SCR05.C02, SCR05.C04, SCR05.C05. Read-only until exact protected commit; error/conflict never applies a partial mutation. Owner may inspect reason,
explicitly retry when safe, or cancel/discard; no automatic uncertain write replay.
SCR05.S2 · Cursor expired: show retention boundary
Disabled: none except standard permission/target readiness gates. Read-only until exact protected commit; error/conflict never applies a partial mutation. Owner may inspect
reason, explicitly retry when safe, or cancel/discard; no automatic uncertain write replay.
SCR05.S3 · Backend death/orphan/revoke: payload hidden; cleanup may be unknown
Disabled: SCR05.C05. Read-only until exact protected commit; error/conflict never applies a partial mutation. Owner may inspect reason, explicitly retry when safe, or
cancel/discard; no automatic uncertain write replay.
SCR05.S4 · Closed delivery: show confirmed or unknown cleanup
Disabled: SCR05.C02. Read-only until exact protected commit; error/conflict never applies a partial mutation. Owner may inspect reason, explicitly retry when safe, or
cancel/discard; no automatic uncertain write replay.
